samples.question: This picture contains one slab: a four-by-four block of sixteen square tiles of the same size, separated by thin dark lines. Every mark outside the slab is inert decoration and changes nothing. Read the sixteen tiles in reading order, that is row by row starting at the top-left tile, each row left to right. The top-left tile is filled edge to edge with one solid colour, and that colour is the single chip already stacked on an imaginary spike. Each of the fifteen remaining tiles is one instruction, applied in reading order. A tile carrying a small coloured disk means put one chip of that colour on top of the stack. A tile carrying a dark cross means take the top chip off the stack and discard it. The removals never empty the stack, and the only chip colours are red, green, blue and purple. After all fifteen instructions have been applied, which colour is the chip on top of the stack? Answer with one of red, green, blue or purple.
